Q1: Which branch should the fix target?
Choices:
A) PR #7066's head branch `ai/issue-7060`, where the failing tests and the `FAKE_GH` changes live. The fix lands in that PR and turns its CI green. (RECOMMENDED)
B) The default branch (`main`). The cited tests are not there, so this works only after PR #7066 merges.
C) Close this issue and fix the fixture directly in PR #7066 through its own review/autofix loop.
Q2: If the tests still fail once `FAKE_GH` makes the new tracker show up in the label-filtered listing and returns the paginated comments, what is in scope?
Choices:
A) Change only test fixtures in `tests/test_unblock_judge.py`. Keep the writer's convergence check in `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` as it is. Record any remaining writer error as a finding instead of changing production code. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Also allow a small change to `scripts/unblock_judge.sh` so it sends the writer's stderr to the log instead of suppressing it, keeping the existing outcome logic unchanged.
C) Allow changes to `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` if the fixture alone does not fix the tests.
